scope: terminal client contract coverage: configure an agent (identity, role, model, base URL, protocol, contextBytes) from the terminal, closing the create-session -> configure-agents loop
role_mapping: pane 1 -> coordinator, panes 2-4 -> worker; the user cannot pick a role, matching the agent/list pane mapping
id_generation: empty pane gets uuid::Uuid::new_v4(); an existing agent keeps its id and prefills model/baseUrl/protocol/contextBytes from agent/list
local_validation: model 1..200 bytes; contextBytes 4096..1000000; baseUrl mirrors core Agent::validate (https, or http on localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]; no credentials/query/fragment). Host remains authoritative and its errors are surfaced verbatim
protocol_field: toggle via Left/Right/Space between responses and chat_completions; not free text
